aboutPage.meta.description: HatchGrab builds software for food trucks and mobile catering: online orders, pickup times, fewer repeated questions. Founder: Dominic Bonini.
aboutPage.meta.title: About us — HatchGrab
aboutPage.story.build: We build practical software especially for food trucks and mobile catering, which helps take online orders, manage pickup times, keep a smooth flow of orders and spend less time on repeated questions.
aboutPage.story.change: HatchGrab was created to change that.
aboutPage.story.fixedAddress: Yet most of the software available to them is designed for businesses with a permanent address.
aboutPage.story.focus: Our aim is simple: make running a food truck easier with tools built the way these businesses actually work.
aboutPage.story.start: HatchGrab began with a simple observation: food trucks need better tools to run their business.
aboutPage.story.villageFoodie: After creating Village Foodie — a directory that helps people find food trucks appearing near them — I spent more time studying the difficulties of mobile food businesses. Unlike ordinary restaurants, food trucks constantly move, work in different places and serve customers in changing conditions.
aboutPage.title: Built the way food trucks actually work

comparison.explained.title: What the features mean
comparison.faq.capacityA: Customers only see the collection times your kitchen can really make. The system takes into account each dish’s preparation time and how many you prepare at once.
comparison.faq.capacityQ: How does the system prevent my kitchen being overloaded?
comparison.faq.costA: {plans}. Stripe’s fees also apply to online card payments: {cardFee} per card payment.
comparison.faq.costTrial: {months, plural, one {The first # month is free} other {The first # months are free}}, with all features.
comparison.faq.locationsA: Yes. You draw up your weekly schedule with places and times, and customers order for the place and day when you are there.
comparison.faq.locationsQ: Does it work with changing locations?
comparison.faq.paymentsA: Customers pay online by card, Apple Pay or Google Pay, or pay at the food truck. PayPal and Klarna are not supported at the moment.
comparison.faq.paymentsQ: Which payment methods does HatchGrab support?
comparison.faq.termA: No. There is neither a minimum term nor a notice period. You can cancel at any time. The fee is charged monthly in advance, and access is kept until the end of the paid month.
comparison.faq.title: Frequently asked questions
comparison.faq.tseA: HatchGrab is not a till system and has no TSE. How to record online orders in your till system is a question for your tax adviser.
comparison.faq.tseQ: Do I still need a till system with a TSE?
comparison.faq.whatA: An ordering system takes orders online before customers reach the food truck. They choose dishes and a collection time, pay online or on collection, and the order appears in your kitchen. A till system or card terminal takes payment at the food truck. They complement each other.

featuresPage.detail.accountant_reports: Sales, taxes and refunds for any month, quarter or tax year, ready to download for your accountant.
featuresPage.detail.advance_preordering: Let customers order for a future date or time before the event.
featuresPage.detail.auto_accept: Online orders are accepted automatically — no need to confirm each one.
featuresPage.detail.branded_qr_code: Add your logo to your QR code.
featuresPage.detail.buzzer_tracking: When you hand out a buzzer, attach its number to the order, so you know which buzzer belongs to which order.
featuresPage.detail.customer_display: A screen visible to customers that shows order numbers and when they are ready.
featuresPage.detail.discovery_map_listin: Your food truck appears on HatchGrab’s public map, so nearby customers find you.
featuresPage.detail.documents_reminders: Keep your certificates in one place, for example food hygiene, insurance and gas safety. We will remind you before any of them expires, and you can send them to an event or market organiser with one tap.
featuresPage.detail.embed_schedule: Show your upcoming dates on your own website. Each one leads straight to its ordering page.
featuresPage.detail.event_types: Create your own event types, with custom prices and settings for events and festivals.
featuresPage.detail.kitchen_app: The most complete way to work with HatchGrab: a live kitchen screen, and also the only way to keep taking orders when you lose signal.
featuresPage.detail.kitchen_capacity: Specify how much your kitchen can cook at once and how long it takes. When a time slot is full, customers can no longer choose it.
featuresPage.detail.loyalty_stamp_cards: Reward repeat customers with digital stamp cards — stamps are collected and redeemed automatically.
featuresPage.detail.meal_deals_upsells: Combine items into combos and offer add-ons when the order is placed, to increase the average order.
featuresPage.detail.messenger_instagram_: The same as WhatsApp auto-replies, but for questions coming via Messenger and Instagram.
featuresPage.detail.multi_device_kitchen: Use several screens — at the counter and in the kitchen, all showing the same live orders.
featuresPage.detail.multi_user_access: Give staff separate logins with the appropriate level of access.
featuresPage.detail.offline_protection: If the connection is lost, online orders pause so customers cannot place orders you won’t see. The iPhone, iPad and Android app lets you keep taking orders offline, while the web dashboard needs a connection.
featuresPage.detail.online_payments: Take card payment in advance when customers order online, via Stripe.
featuresPage.detail.preorder_deadline: Set an order deadline for items that need to be ordered in advance.
featuresPage.detail.private_events: Add private events that don’t appear on the map, with their own private ordering link and QR code.
featuresPage.detail.profit_per_event: Enter the cost of each dish and see how much you actually earned at every event, not just the takings.
featuresPage.detail.qr_code: A printable QR code that opens your menu and ordering page.
featuresPage.detail.schedule_import: We fill in your schedule automatically — from your website or from the photo you already publish on Facebook. You only check and confirm.
featuresPage.detail.sms_order_alerts: Automatically send customers an SMS when their order is ready.
featuresPage.detail.social_media_posts: Upload your designs — we will automatically add your dates, places and times for each week and event.
featuresPage.detail.sold_out_toggle: Mark any item as sold out with one tap — it immediately turns grey for customers.
featuresPage.detail.stock_countdown: Set a stock quantity and it will go down with orders, and then the item is automatically marked sold out.
featuresPage.detail.tap_to_pay: Take card payments on a supported phone, so you don’t need a separate card terminal.
featuresPage.detail.ticket_printing: Print order tickets in the kitchen on a Bluetooth or wired printer.
featuresPage.detail.time_slot_selection: Customers choose a pickup time slot, and demand is spread across your service.
featuresPage.detail.walkup_orders: Take and manage orders at the food truck’s window, with payment on your own card terminal.
featuresPage.detail.web_dashboard: Manage your service from any phone, tablet or laptop browser.
featuresPage.detail.whatsapp_auto_replie: Automatically answer questions coming via WhatsApp about your menu and schedule.

landing.does.capacityBody: Specify how much you can cook at once and how much time it takes. When a pickup time is full, customers can no longer choose it.
landing.does.devicesBody: Works on the phone in your apron pocket, the tablet on the counter, the laptop in the vehicle — and with the card terminal you already take payments with.
landing.does.lede: Most ordering systems assume a permanent address, stable wifi and the same working hours every week. But you are in a new place every week, at different hours, with weak mobile coverage or none. HatchGrab was built exactly for that.
landing.does.offlineBody: If the connection is lost, online orders pause automatically so customers cannot place orders you won’t see. Keep taking orders with the iPhone, iPad and Android app.
landing.does.postsBody: Upload the design you already publish on Facebook or Instagram. We will fill in your dates, places and times, and it will be ready to publish — every week or every day.

landing.does.slotsBody: Customers order ahead and choose a pickup time. Fewer queues, and the food is ready when they arrive.
landing.does.title: Built for food trucks, not for restaurants.
landing.does.whatsappBody: “Where are you this evening?” “What desserts do you have?” Your WhatsApp answers while you drive to the trading spot or stand at the grill, using your own menu and schedule. Messenger and Instagram coming soon.
